papers.title_en: PATACON: GPU-Parallel Tangent-Bundle RRT-Connect for Constrained Motion Planning
papers.authors: Gahyun Oh, Junho An, Suhyun Jeon, Suhan Park
papers.evidence: 面向人形机器人全身控制的GPU并行运动规划算法
papers.tldr: 受约束的运动规划在碰撞检测与最近邻搜索之外，还需反复进行约束投影，计算开销大；已有 GPU 并行规划器仍在环境构型空间中扩展，偏离流形的候选点投影成为主要瓶颈。PATACON 利用已知约束函数诱导的局部流形几何，在切空间中做 GPU 并行双向探索。在双臂闭链与人形全身约束任务上，随构型维度与约束余维增大优势更明显，最高取得 11.25 倍加速。该工作让 GPU 并行切空间探索把受约束全身运动规划推向实时。
papers.abstract_en: Fast whole-body motion planning enables continuous replanning for humanoid robots in dynamic environments while satisfying collision avoidance and kinematic constraints. However, constrained motion planning incurs substantial computational cost due to repeated constraint projection in addition to collision checking and nearest-neighbor search. Recently, GPU-based massively parallel planners have been proposed to reduce computational cost. Nevertheless, these planners still steer in the ambient configuration space, so projecting candidates that deviate from the manifold remains a significant source of overhead, particularly in highly constrained, high-dimensional problems. In this work, we introduce PATACON, a GPU-parallel bidirectional planner that explores tangent space to exploit the local manifold geometry induced by known constraint functions. Experiments on dual-arm closed-chain and humanoid whole-body constrained planning tasks show that PATACON outperforms the prior work as configuration-space dimension and constraint codimension grow, achieving up to an 11.25 times speedup. These results suggest that GPU-parallel tangent-space exploration brings constrained whole-body motion planning closer to real-time performance.

papers.title_en: A Scalable Learned Iterative Solver for Nonlinear MPC via Temporal Decomposition
papers.evidence: 用于约束最优控制的可学习原始-对偶迭代求解器
papers.tldr: NMPC实时应用受在线优化求解成本制约，神经网络控制律近似又可能违反约束且依赖预计算解。LISCO以自监督学习预测满足KKT条件的原始-对偶步，无需预计算解，但其单体架构随预测时域膨胀。本文利用问题时间结构改造求解器架构，使网络规模不再依赖时域，并用闭环重采样对齐训练分布。在CSTR级联经济NMPC上，该方法可扩展至更大问题，较IPOPT中位加速最高4倍，闭环性能相当且未观察约束违反。
papers.abstract_en: Nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) can be applied to large nonlinear systems with complex objectives while enforcing constraints, but the cost of solving the underlying optimization problems limits real-time application for systems with fast dynamics or many states. Neural networks can reduce this online cost by approximating the control law, but may violate constraints and typically require many precomputed optimizer solutions for training. The learning-based iterative solver for constrained optimization (LISCO) instead learns to predict primal-dual steps toward satisfaction of the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions through self-supervised training without precomputed solutions, but its dense, monolithic architecture grows with the prediction horizon. We remove this horizon dependence by exploiting the temporal structure of the problem in the solver architecture, which makes the network size independent of the horizon while leaving the training loss and the solver iteration unchanged. A closed-loop resampling strategy further aligns the training distribution with closed-loop operation at no additional sampling cost. On an economic NMPC benchmark of a CSTR cascade, the proposed solver scales to larger problems than monolithic LISCO and achieves median speedups of up to a factor of four over IPOPT. In closed loop, it achieves comparable control performance to IPOPT with no observed constraint violations.

papers.title_en: DEFlow: Deep Equilibrium Flow Maximum-Entropy Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Ruslan Ageev, Huaze Tang, Runqing Miao, Jiarong Li, Wenbo Ding
papers.evidence: 在软演员-评论家框架内训练的深度平衡流策略
papers.tldr: 流策略能表达多个高价值动作，但少步采样与可处理动作密度难以兼得。DEFlow将显式欧拉采样改为隐式欧拉积分，把全部中间动作作为平衡系统联合求解。它结合隐式微分与最终动作密度的离散变量变换公式，使SAC可在不反传求解器迭代的情况下离策略训练。在Multi-Goal docking四个变体上平均成功覆盖相对最强基线提升约10%，并在五个操作任务中的四个取得最高平均时间回报。
papers.abstract_en: Expressive flow policies can represent multiple high-value actions, but sampling them with few integration steps while retaining tractable action densities remains challenging. We introduce DEFlow, a deep equilibrium flow policy that replaces explicit Euler sampling with implicit Euler integration and solves all intermediate actions jointly as an equilibrium system. We combine implicit differentiation with a discrete change-of-variables formula for the final-action density, enabling off-policy training within soft actor-critic without backpropagating through solver iterations. DEFlow achieves an average relative improvement of approximately 10% in mean successful coverage over the strongest baseline across four Multi-Goal docking variants. It also achieves the highest mean time-averaged return on four of five manipulation tasks, while remaining broadly competitive across five MuJoCo tasks. These results support implicit flow policies for tasks requiring both diversity and precision, at the cost of additional nonlinear and linear solves. Primary

papers.title_en: Planning to Learn: Real-Time Robust Adaptive Control on the GPU with Guaranteed Future Learning
papers.authors: Anutam Srinivasan, Siddhant Panse, Glen Chou
papers.evidence: GPU加速的鲁棒自适应模型预测控制求解器
papers.tldr: 鲁棒自适应控制需在未知环境中兼顾安全与降低不确定性，但传统规划常忽略未来参数学习而偏保守，且难扩展到高维系统。A-SLS 将学习感知引入基于系统级合成的 RAMPC，预测未来参数不确定性并保留扰动、参数误差与估计更新的相关性，构造更紧的保证可达集。作者还实现 GPU 加速求解器，在非线性机器人上降低可达管保守性并保持实时性，扩展到 61 维四足全身控制。硬件 Crazyflie 也能在线学习未知动力学参数并稳定飞行。
papers.abstract_en: Robust adaptive control is vital for keeping robots safe while actively reducing uncertainty in unfamiliar settings. However, traditional methods are often conservative since they fail to account for guaranteed future parameter learning during planning and struggle to scale to high-dimensional systems. In this work, we present A-SLS, a learning-aware robust adaptive model predictive control (RAMPC) framework based on system-level synthesis. A-SLS forecasts future parameter uncertainty and preserves correlations between process disturbances, parameter error, and estimate updates to construct tight, guaranteed reachable sets that account for future information gain. We also develop a GPU-accelerated A-SLS solver to enable real-time performance. Across nonlinear robotic systems, A-SLS reduces reachable-tube conservativeness, maintains real-time performance, and scales to whole-body control for a quadruped with 61 states, 8 uncertain parameters, and 12 control inputs. We further demonstrate the approach on hardware, where a physical Crazyflie drone learns an uncertain dynamics parameter online to stabilize on the fly.

papers.title_en: Minimum-Energy Control for Stochastic Linear Systems
papers.evidence: 将随机最小能量控制问题建模为二次约束二次规划的最优控制研究
papers.tldr: 该文研究随机线性时不变系统的开环最小能量控制问题，目标是在终端误差足够小的随机约束下最小化控制能量。作者将随机MEC建模为QCQP并求得最优解，提出随机可控性与随机Gram矩阵等新概念，证明其推广了确定性MEC。结果还揭示最优控制能量存在不可通过延长时域克服的基本下界，为随机控制能量极限提供理论依据。
papers.abstract_en: The open-loop minimum-energy control (MEC) problem asks for control inputs that minimize the control energy while ensuring the terminal state reaches a desired value. In this paper, we study the open-loop MEC problem for stochastic linear time-invariant systems. We consider a variety of stochastic constraints that enforce the terminal error to be \emph{small}, and show that Stochastic MEC (SMEC) problem can be formulated as a QCQP. We obtain the optimal solution for SMEC and show that it generalizes the well-known Deterministic MEC problem by introducing novel stochastic variants of controllability and Gramian matrices. Finally, we show that there exists a fundamental lower bound on the optimal control energy which cannot be overcome by increasing the time horizon of the problem.

papers.title_en: Human-Like Redundancy Resolution for Real-Time Bimanual Humanoid Teleoperation
papers.authors: Chao Tan, Ming Shin Cindy Sung, Shuxian Liang, Chaoqun Wan, Zhen Huang, Xian-Sheng Hua
papers.evidence: 面向人形遥操作的冗余解析与腕部跟踪
papers.tldr: 双机械臂人形遥操作需在准确跟踪手腕的同时保持手臂构型可预测，但7自由度手臂对同一腕姿存在多组肘部解，仅跟踪手腕易致肘漂移或构型突变。为此，作者提出类人冗余分解框架：用肩腕几何重定向生成腕目标，以自适应肘偏移准则随手臂伸直逐步释放冗余自由度，并用分层速度求解器将肘部引导投影到腕任务零空间。固定腕目标消融中肘方向误差降54.4%，工作空间边界压力测试中峰值原始关节速度需求较无阻尼伪逆降97.9%。
papers.abstract_en: Real-time bimanual humanoid teleoperation requires accurate wrist tracking while keeping arm configurations predictable. Because a 7-DoF arm admits multiple elbow configurations for the same wrist pose, wrist-only tracking can cause elbow drift or abrupt configuration changes. Fixed anthropomorphic constraints can stabilize elbow posture, but they can also block the redundant adjustments needed near singular configurations. We propose a human-like redundancy-resolution framework that combines adaptive elbow guidance with singularity-robust wrist tracking. Shoulder-wrist geometric retargeting generates robot-scale wrist targets. An adaptive elbow-offset criterion uses the offset direction to guide posture and scales this guidance by the offset magnitude, so the redundant degree of freedom is progressively released as the human arm straightens. A hierarchical velocity solver prioritizes wrist tracking and projects the adaptive elbow guidance into the wrist-task null space. In a fixed-wrist-target ablation, adaptive guidance reduces mean elbow-direction error by 54.4% compared with removing this guidance. In a workspace-boundary stress test, singularity-robust tracking reduces peak raw joint-velocity demand by 97.9% compared with the undamped pseudoinverse. Real-world bimanual tasks and cross-platform retargeting show applicability across robot morphologies.

papers.title_en: Model-Based Online Decision Making via Generative Trajectory Planning
papers.authors: Haldun Balim, Yilun Du, Na Li
papers.evidence: 结合动力学奖励与价值模型的基于模型轨迹优化
papers.tldr: 在线决策需兼顾推理效率与长程推理：价值方法受短视自举限制，轨迹优化每步求解高维问题。GTP 将生成模型作为动作序列提案分布，从扩散先验采样候选并用学习到的动力学、奖励和价值模型精炼。在连续控制与长程操作任务上，GTP 匹配或超越无模型、扩散策略和基于模型基线，并在强基线退化时保持稳定。其意义在于把生成模型理解为规划的结构化提案分布，而非策略本身。
papers.abstract_en: Online decision-making faces a tension between efficient inference and long-horizon reasoning. Value-based methods rely on short-horizon bootstrapping that limits the propagation of long-term information, while trajectory optimization methods plan explicitly but must solve a high-dimensional optimization problem at every decision step. We propose Generative Trajectory Planning (GTP), a model-based framework that addresses this tension by learning a generative model as a proposal distribution over action sequences. Instead of optimizing sequences from scratch, GTP samples candidate sequences from a diffusion prior and refines them using learned dynamics, reward, and value models, enabling efficient trajectory-level reasoning. Across continuous control and long-horizon manipulation tasks, GTP matches or exceeds state-of-the-art model-free, diffusion-policy, and model-based baselines, and remains stable in regimes where strong baselines degrade. Our results suggest that generative models are best understood not as policies, but as structured proposal distributions for planning, offering a new perspective on how to integrate generative modeling with model-based decision-making.

papers.title_en: $λ_0$: Scaling Open-World Egocentric Human Data for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.evidence: 面向人形移动操作的由人至人形运动参考与控制器精修
papers.tldr: 人形全身移动操作依赖大规模机器人演示，但采集成本高，现有自我中心人类数据又缺少移动与姿态信息。作者构建500小时HumanVerse数据集，并提出人类到人形对齐与离线运动细化流程，开发全身基础模型λ0。零样本迁移Unitree G1在SIMPLE达90.0%，真实任务平均62.5%。该工作展示了可扩展人类数据监督人形全身操作的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated whole-body interaction with the physical world, yet collecting robot demonstrations at scale remains costly. Human demonstrations offer a scalable alternative, but existing egocentric human supervision often omits locomotion and posture, while embodiment differences and controller dynamics hinder accurate end-effector execution. We introduce HumanVerse, a 500-hour dataset of open-world human loco-manipulation pairing egocentric video with synchronized body and hand motion. Our human-to-humanoid pipeline aligns camera viewpoints and arm appearance, and refines motion references and controller inputs offline to reduce end-effector errors while preserving whole-body coordination. We validate the pipeline through zero-shot transfer to Unitree G1 on representative whole-body manipulation and long-range loco-manipulation tasks, without target-task robot demonstrations. Building on this pipeline, we develop $λ_0$, a humanoid foundation model for whole-body loco-manipulation, with robot-aligned human demonstrations providing supervision for mid-training. Increasing whole-body human data consistently improves downstream task progress. $λ_0$ achieves 90.0% success on SIMPLE and 62.5% across real-world loco-manipulation tasks. We expect this study to guide scalable whole-body human data collection toward humanoid foundation models for richer interaction with the physical world. Homepage: https://lambdahumanoid.github.io/

papers.title_en: Value-Guided Repulsion for Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Yixue Hao, Jiahao Zhang, Jiesong Lian, Xufei Guo, Xumeng Guo, Wenhui Zhang, Long Hu, Rui Wang
papers.evidence: 离线强化学习中价值函数引导的策略设计
papers.tldr: 离线强化学习中的漂移策略虽高效稳定，但其排斥仅由生成动作的几何关系决定，无法按期望价值区分动作。VRQL将归一化Q值缩放引入粒子交互场，使低价值粒子受到更强排斥，同时保留对行为动作的吸引。在50个OGBench任务配置和6个D4RL AntMaze配置上，VRQL与成熟基线相比表现很有竞争力。该工作表明价值引导的粒子交互是提升离线RL策略设计的有效途径。
papers.abstract_en: Drifting models have emerged as a highly efficient and stable paradigm for policy design in offline reinforcement learning (RL). However, standard drift policies determine repulsion solely from geometric relationships among generated actions and therefore cannot distinguish them by expected value. To address this limitation, we introduce Value-Guided Repulsion Q-Learning (VRQL) to integrate action value estimates into the particle interaction field. For each state, VRQL combines geometric kernel distance with a normalized Q value scaling. This mechanism assigns greater repulsive influence to particles with lower values while strictly retaining attraction toward behavior action. Consequently, this value-guided interaction field aligns behavior regularization with policy improvement without adding an auxiliary behavior model stage. On 50 OGBench task configurations and 6 D4RL AntMaze configurations, VRQL demonstrates highly competitive performance against established baselines, suggesting that value-guided particle interaction is an effective method for offline RL.

papers.title_en: LightHybridNet: A Lightweight Hybrid Deep Learning Framework for Efficient Multi-Label Ophthalmic Disease Classification in Imbalanced Fundus Images
papers.authors: Hem Raj Dadral Najam Ul Hasan, Naveed Ejaz, Muhammad Aslam Jarwar
papers.evidence: 采用深度可分离卷积与复合缩放构建高效轻量网络
papers.tldr: 眼底图像中视网膜病变特征细微复杂，多标签眼科疾病分类仍具挑战。本文提出轻量混合深度学习框架LightHybridNet，结合深度可分离卷积与复合缩放机制，并配合直方图均衡、色彩空间转换与图像增强等预处理。在ODIR-5K八类疾病数据集上，其加权F1达91.51%、宏AUC达98.26%、Cohen's Kappa为90.14%，优于迁移学习基线。该工作为临床自动化眼病筛查提供了高效可靠的方案。
papers.abstract_en: Eye diseases are a major global cause of blindness and vision impairment, highlighting the need for accurate and early diagnosis to prevent further deterioration. Despite advances in medical imaging, classifying retinal diseases from fundus images remains challenging due to the complexity and subtlety of visual features. This study aims to develop and validate LightHybridNet, a novel lightweight hybrid deep learning framework, to improve the classification of eye diseases from fundus images. The model incorporates architectural features, such as depthwise separable convolutions and compound scaling mechanisms, to enhance diagnostic accuracy and robustness. To validate the model, the ODIR-5K dataset, comprising 8 disease categories, was used. To enhance image quality, pre-processing approaches were applied, including histogram equalisation, colour space conversion, and contrast adjustment, resulting in high-resolution images. Furthermore, image augmentation was employed to increase the dataset size, thereby improving the model's ability to generalise during training. The hybrid architecture helps the model concentrate on relevant image regions while capturing and integrating details at different scales, significantly improving classification performance. To evaluate its effectiveness, the model was compared with transfer-learning models. The results show that LightHybridNet outperforms the baselines, achieving a weighted F1-score of 91.51%, a macro AUC of 98.26%, and a Cohen's Kappa of 90.14% on the validation set. Furthermore, model interpretability was enhanced using explainable AI methods, including Grad-CAM, to identify and emphasise features influencing the decision-making process. LightHybridNet represents a promising advancement in automated ocular disease detection, offering improved diagnostic reliability for clinical use.

papers.title_en: LEAP: Gradient Flow Augmented Lagrangian Trajectory Optimization for Contact Constrained Robots
papers.authors: César E. Ramos Chuquiure, Ryan Tsai, Yutong Zhou, Zihang Huang, Vansh Thakur, Akshunn Trivedi, Zachary Lin, Pearl Lin, Ruikai Yang, Challen Enninful Adu, Ram Vasudevan
papers.evidence: 面向接触约束机器人的增广拉格朗日梯度流最优控制求解
papers.tldr: 腿足与操作机器人需全程满足摩擦锥约束，现有求解器对初值敏感且随关节数增加扩展性差。LEAP用伪谱配点离散最优控制问题，并对PHR增广拉格朗日集成原始-对偶梯度流求解，而非Newton或SQP。它设计带Gauss-Newton度量、动量和merit步长控制的线性隐式积分器，使增广拉格朗日保持单调。在五类机器人基准中，LEAP唯一解出全部问题，部分场景快于Crocoddyl和Aligator，并以更小算力获得可跟踪轨迹，经仿真和硬件验证。
papers.abstract_en: Generating dynamically feasible motions for legged and manipulating robots requires solving a large, nonlinear, non-convex optimal control problem (OCP) in which contact wrenches must satisfy friction-cone constraints throughout the motion, not only at isolated instants. Existing solvers are sensitive to the initial guess and scale poorly with the number of joints. This paper introduces LEAP, which transcribes the OCP with pseudospectral collocation and, instead of a Newton or SQP solve, integrates a primal--dual gradient flow of a Powell--Hestenes--Rockafellar augmented Lagrangian to compute a solution. Because the flow is stiff, this paper designs a linearly implicit integrator with a Gauss--Newton metric, momentum, and a merit-based step controller that keeps the augmented Lagrangian monotone. Across locomotion benchmarks on five robot platforms, from planar hoppers to 32-joint humanoids, LEAP is the only method to solve every tested problem, achieves substantial speedups over Crocoddyl and Aligator on several benchmarks, and reaches trackable references at smaller compute budgets. The resulting trajectories are validated by tracking them in a high-fidelity simulator and on hardware. We will make the code public upon final acceptance of this paper.

papers.title_en: A Palais-Smale type condition for optimal control problems
papers.authors: Jean-Michel Coron, Li Deng, Xu Zhang
papers.evidence: 最优控制问题中最优对的存在性
papers.tldr: 针对无凸性假设、带一般控制约束且固定初始状态的最优控制问题，本文引入源自临界点理论的控制版Palais-Smale型条件，以弥补经典存在性理论的不足。作者证明该条件可保证最优对存在，并验证一类具体最优控制问题满足此条件。文中还通过算例说明有限多个Pontryagin极大值原理候选不能确保最优控制存在，且新条件能处理现有结果失效的情形。该条件对最优控制存在性是充分的，但并非必要。
papers.abstract_en: We consider an optimal control problem with a general control constraint and a fixed initial state, for which convexity assumptions are absent. To establish the existence of optimal pairs, we introduce a control version of the Palais-Smale type condition adapted from critical point theory and prove that optimal pairs exist under this condition (see Theorem 2.1). Subsequently, we verify that a specific class of optimal control problems satisfies our Palais-Smale type condition (see Proposition 2.1). Furthermore, as an application, we present an example (Example 3.1) and show that, to the best of our knowledge, no existing result can be applied to establish the existence of an optimal pair in this case (see Section 3.1.1). Example 3.2 shows that finitely many Pontryagin maximum principle candidates do not guarantee the existence of an optimal control. Finally, Example 3.3 demonstrates that the proposed Palais-Smale type condition is sufficient, but not necessary, for the existence of optimal controls.

papers.title_en: Chronos Policy: Learning Robot Policies on Physical Time
papers.authors: Changhao Wang, Jaden Clark, Shuran Song
papers.evidence: 基于物理时间条件与时间感知RoPE的机器人运动控制策略
papers.tldr: 机器人策略常把传感与控制转为固定频率的观察-动作序列，使物理时间仅隐含在序列位置中，遇到观察率、延迟或推理时延变化时容易失效。Chronos Policy 以观察捕获时刻和动作执行时刻为条件，将物理时间显式注入扩散Transformer，并采用更稳健的time-aware RoPE。训练时随机化观察采样与动作块起始时刻，支持异步多速率数据。仿真和真实实验显示，动态与多感官任务性能提升，准静态任务保持性能并增强时序鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: Robot policies often convert sensing and control into fixed-rate observation-action sequences, leaving physical time implicit in sequence position. This assumption breaks when observation rates or delays vary, or when inference latency changes. We introduce Chronos Policy, which makes physical time explicit by conditioning on observation capture times and desired action execution times. We study two ways to incorporate time into a diffusion transformer: adding timestamp embeddings to token features, or encoding physical time in positional encoding through time-aware rotary positional encodings (time-aware RoPE). We find that time-aware RoPE is more robust, allowing attention to depend directly on physical time while keeping token content unchanged. During training, we temporally randomize which observations are sampled and when the action chunk begins, exposing the policy to a wider range of sensing and execution schedules that may occur during deployments. This also enables learning from asynchronous, multi-rate data without forcing all measurements onto a fixed temporal grid. Across simulation and real-world experiments, Chronos Policy improves performance on dynamic tasks, where observation-to-action timing is critical, and on multisensory tasks, where the relative timing between observations matters. On standard quasi-static tasks, it preserves nominal performance while improving robustness to changes in sensing and inference timing.

papers.title_en: The exact worst-case asymptotic rate of Nesterov acceleration for strongly convex optimization
papers.tldr: 针对光滑强凸优化中标准Nesterov加速梯度法，本文精确刻画到最优解平方距离的最坏情况渐近收缩因子。作者以自相似平面螺旋构造候选轨迹，将精确因子化为固定圆盘上概率测度的线性优化。结果显示最优测度共享同一收缩因子，且该最坏率可由有限维单个函数实现，匹配上界对全类函数一致。由此证明函数、维度和初值随步数变化不恶化因子，并给出1-4/(3√κ)+o(κ^{-1/2})的渐近式。
papers.abstract_en: We study Nesterov's accelerated gradient method with its standard constant parameters for smooth strongly convex optimization. We characterize the exact worst-case asymptotic factor for the squared distance to the minimizer. To this end, we construct candidate worst-case trajectories by combining planar spirals with a common contraction factor that satisfy a self-similarity condition. Each component rotates by a fixed angle at every iteration. The exact factor is the optimal value of a linear optimization problem over probability measures on a fixed disk, with constraints derived from smooth strongly convex interpolation. Every optimal measure has a common contraction factor, which is also the largest factor for which the angular interpolation conditions are feasible. We also show that this worst-case asymptotic rate can be realized by a \emph{single} function in a finite-dimensional space whose iterates attain this factor. A matching upper bound holds uniformly over all functions in the class and all finite dimensions. Consequently, allowing the function, dimension, and initial point to vary with the iteration horizon does not increase the worst-case asymptotic factor. We also show that the exact factor is $1-4/(3\sqrtκ)+o(κ^{-1/2})$ as $κ\to\infty$, where $κ=L/μ$ is the ratio of the gradient Lipschitz constant to the strong convexity parameter.

papers.title_en: StreamingWAM: Streaming World Action Modeling via Chunk-Wise Staircase Flow Matching
papers.authors: Shaojie Ren, Jingwen Sun, Zezhi Liu, Hongjin Chen, Xin Jin, Wei Zou, Zhibo Chen
papers.evidence: 面向通用机器人控制与运动生成的世界动作模型
papers.tldr: 世界动作模型在真实机器人部署时常出现动作不连续、执行抖动，现有方法难以同时兼顾推理效率与跨块连续性。StreamingWAM提出流式扩散框架，结合分块噪声阶梯、前缀推演与稠密视频历史记忆。实验覆盖LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 2.0及真实任务，稳态重规划延迟降至仿真72.9 ms、真机57.3 ms。该方法提升了动静场景下的动作连续性，并降低对执行时域K的敏感性。
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs), often built upon pretrained video-generation world models, have emerged as a promising framework for general-purpose and open-ended robot control. However, their real-world deployment often suffers from discontinuous and jerky execution. Existing methods typically address this issue by either improving inference efficiency or enhancing action continuity across prediction chunks, without jointly addressing both challenges. To bridge this gap, we propose StreamingWAM, a streaming-diffusion framework for WAM-based robot control. StreamingWAM combines a noise ladder for chunk-wise action prediction, a prefix rollout module for cross-chunk continuity, and dense video-history memory for temporally consistent conditioning. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate that StreamingWAM improves action continuity across static and dynamic settings, achieving competitive performance while reducing steady-state replanning latency to 72.9 ms in simulation and 57.3 ms on the real robot. The method also produces smoother action transitions, while the streaming staircase reduces sensitivity to the execution horizon K.

papers.title_en: Drift, Then Spread: Learning One-Step Generative Policies for Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Chunyu Luo, Hongyu Zhao, Guangyi Ni, Yue Song, Lingkai Kong
papers.evidence: 面向在线最大熵强化学习的一步生成式策略与actor更新
papers.tldr: 扩散与流式策略表达力强，但在线强化学习采样迭代成本高。DriftSpread 将 Drifting 用于在线最大熵强化学习，从负最大熵目标推导 critic 引导的 Drift 与熵诱导的 Spread，并在同一 actor 中顺序学习。MuJoCo 上其归一化回报汇总最高，训练与推理效率优于扩散和流式基线。该工作为一步生成策略提供了无需策略密度或得分估计的在线强化学习方案。
papers.abstract_en: Generative policies offer expressive action distributions for online reinforcement learning (RL), but many diffusion- and flow-based policies require costly iterative sampling. We propose DriftSpread, a one-step generative policy based on Drifting for online maximum-entropy (MaxEnt) RL. To incorporate entropy without a tractable policy density, we build on an energy-based view of Drifting and derive critic-guided Drift and entropy-induced Spread from the negative MaxEnt objective. Our method learns these updates sequentially in the same actor, using action regression for value improvement and distribution matching to capture the effect of entropy. The actor updates require neither direct samples from the critic-defined Boltzmann target nor policy-density or score estimation. Under exact fitting with a fixed critic, we prove convergence to the Boltzmann target in the small-step limit followed by the long-time limit. On MuJoCo, DriftSpread achieves the highest aggregate normalized return among all evaluated methods, while outperforming the diffusion- and flow-based baselines in both training and inference efficiency.

papers.title_en: Koopman Operator Inference for the Chemical Master Equation
papers.evidence: 基于EDMD的Koopman算子推断用于非线性随机动力学
papers.tldr: 从分子状态对推断随机反应网络的动力学速率，通常需要先构造化学主方程的巨大状态空间，计算代价很高。本文用扩展动态模式分解估计选定分子状态函数的有限时间演化，再通过矩阵对数得到投影生成元，并借助已知的化学计量关系确定各物种的反应速率。作者构造了由反应通道导出的附加函数，并证明每提升一级闭包，都能把首个偏差项推向更高阶。频谱公式还能识别导致偏差的被忽略模态，并指示矩阵对数何时会放大采样误差。在五个反应网络上的精确计算与实验验证了预测的误差行为，并说明了附加函数在有限样本下改善速率恢复的条件。
papers.abstract_en: We infer kinetic rates of stochastic reaction networks from molecular-state pairs separated by a fixed time lag, without constructing the large state space of the Chemical Master Equation. Extended dynamic mode decomposition estimates the finite-time evolution of selected functions of the molecular state. A matrix logarithm then gives a projected generator whose species rows determine the rates through the known reaction stoichiometry. A finite set of functions introduces a systematic bias. We construct additional functions from the reaction channels and prove that each level of closure moves the first bias term to higher order. Spectral formulas identify the omitted modes responsible for this bias and show when the logarithm amplifies sampling error. Exact calculations and experiments on five reaction networks confirm the predicted error behavior and show when the added functions improve finite-sample rate recovery.

papers.title_en: Trust-Calibrated VLA Policy Post-Training with Evolving Imagination
papers.authors: Wenzhan Li, Yiran Qin, Heng Zhou, Huirui Wang, Yulan Guo, Ruimao Zhang
papers.evidence: 结合在线更新世界模型模拟器的强化学习策略优化
papers.tldr: VLA模型经模仿学习预训练后，部署超出示范覆盖时需强化学习后训练，但无模型方法交互密集、基于模型方法易受不可靠想象影响。MERL将策略优化与在线更新的世界模型和奖励代理头耦合，用模拟器可靠度调节想象数据比例与rollout长度，并用chunk级信任控制回放与优化权重。在扰动LIBERO-PRO上平均成功率79.7%，高阈值学习速度较匹配无模型控制提升10.9%，并在两个真实机器人任务上以每任务50条示范达到80.0%平均成功率。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are often pretrained via imitation learning, making reinforcement learning (RL) post-training important when deployment moves beyond demonstration coverage. Existing refinement paradigms expose a reliability--efficiency tension: model-free refinement avoids simulator bias but is interaction-intensive, whereas model-based refinement can exploit unreliable imagination even as its simulator adapts. We propose Model-Evolving Reinforcement Learning (MERL), a trust-calibrated framework that couples policy optimization with an online-updated simulator comprising a world model and a reward proxy head. Across stages, simulator reliability controls the imagined-data ratio and rollout horizon; within rollouts, chunk-level trust controls replay selection and optimization weight. For recursive imagination without exact grounded continuations, a residual predictor estimates trust without querying future ground truth. On perturbed LIBERO-PRO tasks, MERL reaches 79.7% average success, improves high-threshold learning speed by 10.9% over the matched model-free control, and outperforms same-protocol external baselines across three training seeds. Fixed-data adaptation from 50 demonstrations per task achieves 80.0% average success on two physical-robot tasks.
